skills.description: Locate and read remote repository source without guessing paths or default branches.
Inspect issues and authenticated PR review queues, classify current requests and changed heads, and preserve source evidence.
Review an exact PR head using bounded source reads, recover omitted evidence, run relevant checks and report verified findings.
Inspect exact-head GitHub Actions failures, reproduce and repair operator-authorized CI problems, validate and update the existing PR branch.
Complete PR comment intent through independent verification and review, respecting operator mutation scope.
